title: Pilot planning with a Japanese partner
scenario: Emma from Gusan talks to Mr. Tanaka, IT manager at a trading company in Osaka, about a pilot. Polite business Japanese (keigo). Tanaka's long answer is a chain of verb-final clauses, which tests cutting Japanese phrases on 、 and 。 and keeping up; Emma backchannels with a short 'Mm-hm'.

emma.name: Emma
emma.accent_note: Gusan partner manager, British English. Alice: clear British voice.

tanaka.name: Tanaka
tanaka.accent_note: IT manager in Osaka, polite business Japanese (keigo). George: warm British voice.

turns.speaker: tanaka
turns.text: 本日はお時間をいただき、ありがとうございます。田中と申します。

ref.en: Thank you for your time today. My name is Tanaka.

turns.speaker: emma
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tanaka. I'm Emma from Gusan. Did your team get a chance to try the app?

ref.ja: ありがとうございます、田中さん。Gusanのエマです。チームの皆さんにアプリをお試しいただけましたか？
ref.en: Thank you, Mr. Tanaka. I'm Emma from Gusan. Did your team get a chance to try the app?

turns.speaker: tanaka
turns.text: はい。えーと、先週、営業部の5人で試してみました。

ref.en: Yes. Um, last week five people from the sales department tried it.

turns.speaker: tanaka
turns.text: 全体的にはとても良かったです。翻訳が速くて、海外のお客様とのZoom会議でも問題なく使えました。ただ、社内の会議では専門用語や製品名が多いので、用語集を事前に登録できると助かります。それから、情報セキュリティ部から、音声データがどこに保存されるのか確認したいと言われています。

ref.en: Overall it was very good. The translation was fast, and it worked without problems even in Zoom meetings with overseas clients. However, our internal meetings have a lot of technical terms and product names, so it would help if we could register a glossary in advance. Also, our information security department wants to confirm where the audio data is stored.

turns.notes: #long #mixed #glossary ~22 s of verb-final (SOV) clauses: cutting on 、 and 。, keep-up; 'Zoom' in Latin letters

turns.speaker: emma
turns.notes: #short #filler backchannel (speak direction: say it or drop it, never stall)

turns.speaker: emma
turns.text: Audio isn't stored on our servers. And yes, you can add a glossary in the settings.

ref.ja: 音声は弊社のサーバーには保存されません。また、用語集は設定から追加できます。
ref.en: Audio isn't stored on our servers. And yes, you can add a glossary in the settings.

turns.speaker: tanaka
turns.text: なるほど、承知しました。

turns.speaker: emma
turns.text: Could we start a pilot with 50 licenses on December 3rd?

ref.ja: 12月3日から、50ライセンスで試験導入を始めることは可能でしょうか？
ref.en: Could we start a pilot with 50 licenses on December 3rd?

turns.speaker: tanaka
turns.text: 社内で確認いたしますが、おそらく大丈夫だと思います。来週の水曜日、午後3時にもう一度お話しできますでしょうか？

ref.en: I'll check internally, but I think it should be fine. Could we talk again next Wednesday at 3 p.m.?

ref.ja: はい、大丈夫です。ありがとうございます。

turns.speaker: tanaka
turns.text: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします。

ref.en: Thank you as well. We look forward to working with you.

turns.notes: #formal a set courtesy phrase with no literal English equivalent
